author: jason6769
quote:
Karantika (also spelled garantita or calentica) is a savory Algerian chickpea-flour flan baked until golden on top and soft inside. Here is a classic recipe using 250 g of chickpea flour.Ingredients
• 250 g (about 2 cups) chickpea flour
• 1 L (4 cups) water• 3 tbsp olive oil (or neutral vegetable oil)
• 2 tsp ground cumin (plus extra for serving)
• 1 tsp salt• 1 tsp black pepper (optional)
• 1–2 eggs, beaten (optional, for a firmer, custard-like texture)

Instructions
1. Make a smooth paste: Put the chickpea flour in a bowl. Whisk in about a third of the water until smooth and lump-free.
2. Finish the batter: Stir in the oil, salt, black pepper, and cumin. Gradually whisk in the rest of the water (and beaten egg, if using) until the batter is thin and runny.
3. Rest the batter: Let it sit for at least 30–60 minutes (or several hours) so the flour hydrates.
4. Prep and bake: Preheat the oven to 220°C (430°F) and lightly oil a baking dish. Stir the batter, pour it in, and bake for 25–30 minutes (or longer for deeper baking dishes) until the top is browned and the center is set yet slightly jiggly.
5. Serve hot: Slice and eat warm. Sprinkle with extra cumin and serve on its own or tucked into a baguette with harissa.
